description:
Create a session handoff note so the next session picks up where this one left off. Write what you worked on, what's pending, and any blockers.

Args:
  summary: What was accomplished this session
  pending: What's left to do (optional)
  blockers: Any blockers or open questions (optional)
  agent: Optional writer attribution stored in frontmatter (e.g. 'codex')

Returns path to the handoff note.
name: create_handoff
